structurePatterns: inline: local content-flow feedback with contained radius, local width, status icon + message block + optional contextual action
banner: page/region notification slot with flatter edge/inset-aware geometry and action/dismiss aligned to banner edge
warning + inline and warning + banner MUST remain structurally distinguishable even when neither has a title
status uses icon shape + readable text; never color alone
usageHints: Inline Alert is persistent local contextual feedback attached to a section/form group/card/task region
Banner is persistent page/region-scope notification placed in a structural notification slot
severity alone never chooses Banner; scope chooses presentation
short success acknowledgement normally belongs to Toast/Snackbar
host/system notifications are not content Banners
doNotInvent: no same rounded card for inline/banner with width as the only difference
no accent-cyan as a fifth status tone
no Banner for transient saved-success feedback
intent: Provide persistent contextual feedback at either local-content scope (Inline Alert) or page/region scope (Banner) without turning transient acknowledgements or task outcomes into persistent chrome.

banner.layout: icon + concise message-block + optional action + optional edge-dismiss

platformPresentationRefs.note: Banner placement consumes page/host geometry and must stay outside host-owned chrome.
